title: Source batch
description: Connector to hub: main-ring entries of one chat's daemon, read from GET /api/events or GET /api/events/stream (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/server/routes/events.js:69, :167), plus captures rebuilt from GET /api/captures?since (C-07.11, C-07.12). Every entry and record is reduced to contract 11's C-11.18 allowlist by the connector before it sends; the hub applies it again before it stores (C-07.8). Carried inside a contract 05 frame.

chat_id.description: The chat label (contract 03 section 2): the chat id without its `cht_` prefix, as every 05 frame names a chat on the link. The hub maps it to the chat id it records.

boot.description: A daemon's per-boot token, read from the X-WC-Boot response header where the daemon sends it (C-07.9, Q-07.1), else from GET /api/health (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/server/routes/health.js:131). Today `${pid}:${Date.now()}` from lib/server/index.js:156; from alpha.4 random per createServer and without the pid (C-07.15, Q-07.8). Opaque to the hub: compared for equality only, never parsed (C-07.36).

since.description: The since the connector read with.

contiguous.description: True only when the batch provably continues the hub cursor (C-07.11): in a live stream its first entry is the cursor's ring position + 1 in the same boot, each capture counting one position; in a catch-up replay with since > 0, its first non-capture entry is since + 1. False with no gap object makes the hub record one source.gap unknown with dropped null.

gap.description: Present when the read answered gap: the fields bus.read returned (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/core/bus.js:208-218), or the SSE gap event (events.js:128). Until Q-07.2 lands, the connector does not trust gap or dropped when the ring's oldest entry may be a capture (bus.js:212), and then sends the batch as not contiguous without this object (C-07.11).

dropped.description: Entries the ring evicted between since and oldest; 0 with reset.

oldest.description: The ring's oldest retained seq as served (for a capture, its counter, until Q-07.2's rename).

reset.description: True when since was ahead of the ring: the daemon restarted under the cursor.

entries.description: Ring entries in ascending ring position, read at host level and reduced by the connector to contract 11's C-11.18 allowlist (C-07.8).

items.description: One ring entry: {seq, ts, kind, ...fields} as bus.emit built it. Open: the field set is the daemon's.

seq.description: The served seq (for kind capture, the capture counter until Q-07.2's rename; after it, the ring position).

reinit.description: True on the batch that carries the first entry or record of a new boot when the connector, reading GET /api/captures?since and GET /api/elements?since once at that boot change before the batch, found a re-initialised surface (C-07.12a): a capture next_cursor (state.captureSeq, lib/server/routes/capture.js:289), or a capture entry's counter, below the cursor's capture_seq. The hub then records one source.gap reinit, raises surface_gen by 1 and sets capture_seq and element_seq to 0, in this batch's transaction and before it keys the batch's entries. An element next_cursor below element_seq alone does not set it: it sets element_seq to 0 and leaves surface_gen.

reconciled.description: Capture records from GET /api/captures?since that a catch-up read or a non-contiguous batch left out (C-07.12). Best effort: the route lists only the live captures, at most CAPTURES_LIVE_MAX 50 (lib/server/domain/captures.js:45), emptied by a Wipe or New graph. The hub stores each as a kind capture event with source.via reconcile.

items.description: A capture's identity, without its body (bodies are fetched by tool call or per contract 11).

kind.description: Only captures are reconciled into the stream in v1.

element_reset.description: true when the connector found the daemon's element next_cursor below the cursor's element_seq without a capture re-init: the hub sets element_seq to 0 for this batch and leaves surface_gen (C-07.12a).
